chunks: And from him, from Fadalah, from Rifah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about a man who forgets to bow (ruku') until he prostrates (sujood) and stands up. He said, 'He faces (the next position).'.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a person who forgets to bow in prayer and goes straight to prostration?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the procedure for a worshipper who forgets the bowing (*ruku'*) and proceeds directly to prostration (*sujood*). The instruction 'yastaqbilu' (he faces) is interpreted by Shia jurists as requiring the individual to face the direction of the missed *ruku'* to complete it before resuming the prayer, thereby preserving the structural integrity of the rak'ah. This ruling highlights the Shia emphasis on maintaining the specific order of pillars (*arkān*) even in cases of forgetfulness, distinguishing it from other schools of thought that might prioritize the prostration of forgetfulness (*sujood al-sahw*) over correcting the missed pillar immediately.
